---
title: "SiPBA Research Group"
image: images/logos/SinFondoClaro.png
toc: false
format: 
  html: 
    include-in-header: _hero_banner.html
    include-after-body: _footer.html

listing:   # Comment the listing section and delete corresponding lines in the index.qmd file to remove the recent posts
  - id: news
    contents: posts
    type: grid
    max-items: 3
    page-size: 3
    fields: [image, date, title, subtitle]
    max-description-length: 75
    sort: 
      - "date desc"
      - "title asc"
  - id: recent-pubs
    contents: 
      - publications/**/*.qmd
      - publications/publications.yml
    exclude:
      title: ""
    type: grid
    max-items: 3
#    image-height: 150px
    page-size: 3 #set same as max-times to remove the page number setting
    fields: [image, title, container-title, author, year]
    include: 
      ENTRYTYPE: "article"
      categories: [featured]
    max-description-length: 75
    sort: 
      - "date desc"
      - "title asc"
    field-display-names: 
        title: "Title"
        author: "Authors"
        container-title: "Journal"
        year: "Year"
---
